installation_summary:
Installed IT-Fachplanung at commit 786839b in /workspace using DDEV (ddev v1.25.4, Docker 29.7.2, Ubuntu 22.04).

Steps:
1. Docker present, ddev absent. Installed ddev manually (verified GitHub release tarball ddev_linux-amd64.v1.25.4.tar.gz → /usr/local/bin) because the official installer refuses root.
2. Created non-root user `ddevuser` (uid 1000, docker group), chowned /workspace; run all ddev commands via `su - ddevuser -c`.
3. `ddev start`: initially the openldap container crash-looped because `.ddev/docker-compose.ldap.yaml` bind-mounted test_users.ldif as a single read-only file (chown/sed/rm failures). Fixed by mounting directory `.ddev/ldap-bootstrap/` and setting `LDAP_REMOVE_CONFIG_AFTER_SETUP=false`. All containers healthy.
4. `ddev composer install --no-interaction` (47 pkgs) — OK.
5. `ddev npm i` (592 pkgs) — OK.
6. `ddev importDump` from dump/db.sql — OK, 9 tables in db schema.
7. `cp config/web.config.local.php.example config/web.config.local.php`; aligned its LDAP block (host=openldap:389, dn=cn=admin,dc=example,dc=org, baseDn=dc=example,dc=org) to the LDAP service in the compose file, since the example referenced a stale planetexpress:10389 endpoint.
8. `ddev setup-docu-data` — OK.

Environment context: ddev project name `tfm-fachplanung`, docroot `public`, PHP 8.3, MariaDB 10.3, apache-fpm; containers ddev-tfm-fachplanung-{web,db,openldap,phpmyadmin,phpldapadmin}. Access at http://tfm-fachplanung.ddev.site. Commands must be run as user `ddevuser`; `ddev cypress` host command is unusable as-is, so Cypress was run directly with `cypress/included:13.17.0` attached to network ddev-tfm-fachplanung_default.

Verification: ddev describe shows web/db/openldap/phpmyadmin OK; HTTP `/`→302 and `/login`→200 with rendered login page; LDAP returns 10 users; Cypress specs 01-infrastruktur_setup (4/4) and 02-benutzerverwaltung (5/5, incl. LDAP search) pass. 030-fachplanung_erstellen had 1/3 fail due to expected 2027 test data not present — a doc-data ordering artifact, not an install defect.
additional_actions: Installed DDEV v1.25.4 manually from the GitHub release tarball via a non-root user because the official install script refuses to run as root and ddev refuses root execution.
Created a non-root user `ddevuser` (uid 1000) with docker group membership and chowned /workspace, then ran all ddev/composer/npm/cypress commands as that user.

Edited .ddev/docker-compose.ldap.yaml: changed the LDIF mount from a single read-only file (../test_users.ldif:ro) to a writable directory (./ldap-bootstrap) and set LDAP_REMOVE_CONFIG_AFTER_SETUP=false so the openldap init could complete.

Changed config/web.config.local.php LDAP settings from the stale example values (ldap:10389 / dc=planetexpress,dc=com) to the LDAP service defined in the project compose file (openldap:389 / dc=example,dc=org).

Ran Cypress directly with the cypress/included:13.17.0 image on the ddev network instead of `ddev cypress`, because the host command's standalone `docker compose` conflicted with the running ddev network and `cypress/included:latest` (Cypress 16) is incompatible with the repository tests.
verification: Ran `su - ddevuser -c 'ddev describe'` → web/db/openldap/phpmyadmin status OK. HTTP check inside web container: `curl` → `/` returns 302 redirect to /login, `/login` returns 200 with the rendered IT-Fachplanung login page. LDAP: `ldapsearch ... "(uid=*)" uid` returned 10 entries. DB: 9 tables in schema `db`. Cypress run (image cypress/included:13.17.0) on spec cypress/e2e/01-infrastruktur_setup.cy.js → "All specs passed! 4 passing, 0 failing" (exit 0); spec cypress/e2e/02-benutzerverwaltung.cy.js → "5 passing, 0 failing" including "erstellt Screenshot der LDAP-Suche" (exit 0). All exit codes 0.
reported_outcome_evidence: ddev start final → 'Successfully started tfm-fachplanung', containers ready
ddev composer install --no-interaction → exit 0, 'Generating autoload files' (47 packages installed)
ddev importDump → exit 0; `ddev mysql -e 'SHOW TABLES;'` lists antragsbuch, dienststelle, dynform_field, fachplanung, gesamtplan, massnahme, teilmassnahme, user, zweck
curl / → code=302 redirect=/login; curl /login → code=200 (full IT-Fachplanung login HTML returned)
ldapsearch -b dc=example,dc=org '(uid=*)' uid → 10 entries (test users loaded)
Cypress 01-infrastruktur_setup.cy.js → 'All specs passed!' Tests:4 Passing:4 Failing:0
Cypress 02-benutzerverwaltung.cy.js → Tests:5 Passing:5 Failing:0; individual test 'erstellt Screenshot der LDAP-Suche ✓' passed after LDAP config alignment
